newsitem.title: USA: First Chicago NBD to swap debt for Nextel shares.
newsitem.headline: First Chicago NBD to swap debt for Nextel shares.

text.p: First Chicago NBD Corp said Friday holders of its Debt Exchangeable for Common Stock (DECS) certificates will receive Class A common shares of Nextel Communications Inc when the DECS mature February 15.

The bank holding company, which spokesman Thomas Kelly said sold the DECS three years ago for $36.25, said it has more than 7.4 million DECS outstanding. The DECS paid 5-1/2-percent interest in each of the three years, he said.

At maturity, DECS holders will receive Nextel common shares determined by an exchange rate based on the average closing price of Nextel for the 20-day period between January 20 through February 14, First Chicago NBD said.
Kelly said the DECS holders will receive one share of Nextel common stock for one DECS certificate if the average price of Nextel shares doesn't exceed $36.25.
Nextel provides wireless radio telecommunications service.
Its shares closed down 3/8 Friday at 14-1/8.
